title: When the Postcards Turns
author: Wendell Whitlock
blurb: Rosalind Yarrow, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
